newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - Fraser rates SembCorp.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Fraser rates SembCorp.

text.p: Fraser Securities said on Thursday SembCorp is rated a long term buy based on its potential earnings from utilities and real estate.

"Interest in SembCorp is mainly derived from the earnings potential of its utility play and the development potential of its landbank. Its share price having weaken since its 1996 results presents opportunities to accumulate the stock," said investment analyst Poh Lay Bin in Fraser's daily circular.
SembCorp shares were unchanged at Singapore $7.15 on Thursday morning trade.

Fraser's said the 1997 earnings for SembCorp's engineering and construction division should rise over 1996 as the division has an orderbook of close to S$1 billion to be booked over the next two years.
It also expected the group's Sempec Utilities Terminals (SUT) project to contribute to profits from 1999.
